preconditions.note: Local Playwright launches a fresh Chromium context with no cookies, so logged-out state is automatic.

steps.description: Navigate to https://app.specterx.com; expect a redirect to /signIn and the sign-in page to render.

screenshot.focus: full sign-in page: Sign in with Google button, 'or sign in with' divider, email/password fields, Sign In button, Reset password link

steps.description: Fill the email field with the SpecterX account email.
Fill the password field with the SpecterX account password.

action.name: Sign In
action.selector_hint: the primary 'Sign In' button below the email and password fields (not 'Sign in with Google')

steps.description: Wait for the My Files dashboard to load after a successful sign-in.

action.selector_hint: My Files heading on the dashboard
action.name: My Files

screenshot.focus: the My Files dashboard heading and the signed-in email in the top-right

postconditions.description: No state created in the tenant during this test — sign-in does not produce shared artifacts. Closing the browser context discards the session.
